pages.text:
You will address me properly or you will not address me at all.

Try again.

Better.

Talk is worth nothing here. I have heard a hundred Blessed explain what they intend
to become. Animal Form. Now. Set your feet and hit me.

[You are put on the ground twice before you land anything at all. The third time,
you land something. It does not move him. He looks at it anyway.]

Hm. Recruits these days. That was almost worth standing up for.

It was the only one you will get from me this year.

Go. The sentry at the south gate writes down the living. Be on her list.
